Autonomous Vehicle Operator

Example Staffing is seeking an Autonomous Vehicle Operator in Atlanta, Georgia. In this role you will operate and monitor autonomous test vehicles on public roads, take manual control when conditions require it, and log detailed observations about vehicle behaviour for the engineering team. Shifts run on a rotating schedule and include some weekend coverage.

Responsibilities include completing pre-trip and post-trip inspections, following defined test routes, documenting disengagements and anomalies accurately, communicating road and weather conditions to the operations desk, and keeping the vehicle interior and sensor housings clean and unobstructed. You will work alongside a safety engineer on most shifts.

Requirements: a valid driver's licence with a clean record for the past three years, comfort with in-vehicle software and tablets, strong written communication for incident logging, and the ability to remain alert and focused during long periods of monitoring. Prior commercial driving, fleet, or vehicle testing experience is helpful but not required - training is provided. This is a full-time contract position with benefits available.
